class.name: vesc_dronecan_driver/VescDroneCanSystem
class.description: Speaks DroneCAN directly over SocketCAN to VESC motor controllers, any mix of driven and steered joints on one bus and one node ID. A joint declaring "esc_index" is a drive wheel: velocity command via uavcan.equipment.esc.RPMCommand, feedback from esc.Status. A joint declaring "actuator_id" is a steering actuator: position command via uavcan.equipment.actuator.ArrayCommand, feedback from actuator.Status. Both id values are the uavcan_esc_index configured on that VESC in VESC Tool. Per-ESC voltage/current/temperature is exported through <gpio> state interfaces keyed by the same esc_index. Steering needs firmware with actuator.ArrayCommand support, which upstream VESC firmware does not have -- see the package README.
